import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

runtime = Path("src/do_again/browser/runtime.py")
tests = Path("tests/test_browser.py")

text = runtime.read_text()

sig_old = '''def send_message(
    target: cdp.Target,
    text: str,
    *,
    timeout: float = 180.0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:'''
sig_new = '''def send_message(
    target: cdp.Target,
    text: str,
    *,
    timeout: float = 180.0,
    wait_for_response: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:'''
if sig_old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("send_message signature not found")
text = text.replace(sig_old, sig_new, 1)

anchor = '''    if not accepted:
        if cdp.evaluate(target, click, timeout=10.0, user_gesture=True) != "clicked":
            raise BrowserError("ChatGPT did not accept the submitted prompt")

    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
'''
replacement = '''    if not accepted:
        if cdp.evaluate(target, click, timeout=10.0, user_gesture=True) != "clicked":
            raise BrowserError("ChatGPT did not accept the submitted prompt")

    if not wait_for_response:
        return {
            "response": "submitted",
            "chat_url": target.url,
        }

    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
'''
if anchor not in text:
    raise SystemExit("send_message acceptance anchor not found")
text = text.replace(anchor, replacement, 1)

notify_start = text.index("@_project_operation\ndef notify_receipt")
notify_end = text.find("\n\n@", notify_start + 10)
if notify_end < 0:
    notify_end = len(text)
notify = text[notify_start:notify_end]

old_primary = '        return send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0)'
new_primary = '        return send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0, wait_for_response=False)'
if old_primary not in notify:
    raise SystemExit("notify primary send not found")
notify = notify.replace(old_primary, new_primary, 1)

old_retry = '        return send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0)'
new_retry = '        return send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0, wait_for_response=False)'
if old_retry not in notify:
    raise SystemExit("notify retry send not found")
notify = notify.replace(old_retry, new_retry, 1)

text = text[:notify_start] + notify + text[notify_end:]
runtime.write_text(text)

test_text = tests.read_text()
test_anchor = '''    def test_duplicate_receipt_marker_is_not_sent_twice(self) -> None:
'''
if test_anchor not in test_text:
    raise SystemExit("test anchor not found")

new_test = '''    def test_notify_receipt_returns_after_submission_without_assistant_response(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            repo = Path(tmp) / "repo"
            repo.mkdir()
            target = cdp.Target(
                "target",
                "https://chatgpt.com/c/project",
                "",
                "ws://127.0.0.1/x",
            )
            with patch.dict(os.environ, {"DO_AGAIN_HOME": str(Path(tmp) / "home")}):
                register_project(
                    repo,
                    remote_url="https://github.com/example/repo.git",
                    control_branch="operator-control",
                    chat_url="https://chatgpt.com/c/project",
                )
                with (
                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime.ensure_browser_running", return_value={"port": 9223}),
                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime._find_chatgpt_target", return_value=target),
                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime.wait_for_authenticated", return_value=(target, {"prompt": True})),
                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime._page_contains", return_value=False),
                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime._assistant_snapshot", return_value={"busy": False}),
                    patch("do_again.browser.runtime._context_limit_warning", return_value=""),
                    patch(
                        "do_again.browser.runtime.send_message",
                        return_value={"response": "submitted", "chat_url": target.url},
                    ) as send_mock,
                ):
                    value = notify_receipt(repo, {"request_id": "req-fast", "state": "succeeded"})
            self.assertEqual(value["response"], "submitted")
            self.assertFalse(send_mock.call_args.kwargs["wait_for_response"])

''' + test_anchor

tests.write_text(test_text.replace(test_anchor, new_test, 1))

subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "add", str(runtime), str(tests)], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Make receipt delivery complete on submission"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
